facts.fact: The Haute Cour Constitutionnelle ruled on 10 July 2024 that the African Union Convention on Cybersecurity and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention) and law n°2024-004 authorising its ratification, adopted by the Assemblée Nationale on 20 June and the Sénat on 21 June 2024, conform to the Constitution.
facts.system: Convention de l'Union Africaine sur la Cybersécurité et la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (Convention de Malabo)
